# Founders Directory

Founders Directory is a premium, developer-focused platform designed to help users search for YCombinator startups and discover founders. 
It provides startup data, founder social links, and AI-powered personalized cold DMs.

## Purpose
This website allows founders, investors, and developers to explore startups backed by top VCs and connect with their teams.

## Available Content
- / : Homepage with searchable startup directory
- /company/[slug] : Detailed information about specific companies and their founders
- /profile : User profiles (requires authentication)

## Documentation and Code
Built with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, and Firebase.

## Crawling
Crawlers are welcome to index public directories (homepage and company pages). Please respect the robots.txt file.

Sitemap: https://foundersdirectory.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://foundersdirectory.com/robots.txt
